jobs.occupation: Sales Manager (m/f/d) MultiVacc - Pay-by-Use Solution for Egg & Poultry (Berufsspezialist/in - Vertrieb)
jobs.description:
Under the motto “Taking action for future generations”, we at Big Dutchman have been conveying our ideas to more than 100 countries for over 85 years – because feeding the world is our profession. Our high-tech farming solutions for proteins and plants make our customers successful and empower farmers around the world to act more sustainably. And no wonder, because whether at our headquarters in Vechta (Germany) or at our locations on five continents: in our family-owned company, more than 3,500 motivated employees provide animal-friendly and sustainable solutions. As a driver of innovation, we never lose sight of the appreciation we have for our team. We enjoy our daily business and take action for future generations together.

Does this sound like the working environment you are looking for? Then join our team in Vechta as a

Sales Manager (m/f/d) MultiVacc - Pay-by-Use Solution for Egg & Poultry

What will be your responsibilities?

- Independently manage the MultiVacc sales process end-to-end: from a qualified opportunity to an active customer contract
- Collaborate with the Egg and Poultry sales teams: take over leads, structure them, and convert them into concrete offers
- Execute the pay-by-use model operationally: clear quoting logic, defined item/code numbers, and clean commercial processing
- Act as the central point of contact for customers: clarify commercial topics and provide basic technical support; coordinate with PM/PO as needed
- Own the Phase 1 rollout in Europe and help build the foundation for later global scaling

What do you bring to the role?

- Several years of experience in Sales / Business Development in the agriculture or livestock sector (Egg/Poultry is a plus)
- Relevant professional background in veterinary medicine (poultry), animal husbandry/livestock sciences, agriculture—or comparable hands-on expertise
- Ability to explain complex solutions and commercial models clearly and negotiate confidently
- Very good German and English skills, spoken and written
- Additional languages are welcome (e.g., Dutch, Romanian, Polish)

Much more than just a job!

- Flexible working hours and mobile work - for a better work-life balance.
- Our Big Dutchman Academy for personal and professional development.
- Our Big Dutchman Card with tax-free benefits in kind.
- A company restaurant with a delicious menu selection.
- E-bike and e-car leasing and company fitness.

Let's talk!

Our HR Business Partner Mareike Reckfort is looking forward to getting to know you and will be happy to answer any questions: E-Mail jobs@bigdutchman.de (https://jobs.bigdutchman.com/job/Vechta-Sales-Manager-%28mfd%29-MultiVacc-Pay-by-Use-Solution-for-Egg-&-Poultry/1386341433/jobs@bigdutchman.de) .

You want to convince us right away?

Send us your detailed application documents, including your salary expectations and earliest possible starting date.

jobs.occupation: Lead Architect - Snowflake (all genders, full-/part-time) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

Your Role

Are you ready to shape the future of Data & AI for our Enabling Functions? Join our team as the Snowflake Lead Architect for Finance and play a key role within our Data & AI Organization (MDAO) - a highly engaged team of data enthusiasts and AI specialists and our Finance Transformation program.

Our mission is to design, build, and run analytics solutions that deliver actionable insights to address business challenges and provide strategic data products to our partners across the Enabling Functions, including Finance, HR, Procurement, Legal, and many more.

Your primary responsibilities will include designing, modernizing, and maintaining the architecture of our new financial reporting and analytics ecosystem, grounded in a deep understanding of business objectives and aligned with IT strategy and architecture goals. You will lead the implementation of our new Data Management Platform on Snowflake, drive the Finance Data Product build, and deliver cloud-native data and analytics solutions.

You will establish standards and best practices for governance, reliability, and delivery across the Enabling Functions, and actively engage in internal and external networks to share knowledge, mentor colleagues, and build capabilities across the organization.

You will guide and consult development teams, internal stakeholders, and integration partners in selecting and implementing the right technology solutions, always keeping the bigger picture in mind. Monitoring architecture-related metrics and KPIs will ensure continuous improvement, reducing time to insight and action.

Your responsibilities will also include technology scouting, creating cost transparency, driving optimization measures, supporting RFPs, and hosting knowledge-sharing sessions. You will represent the team and our company at internal and external events.

If you are curious and ambitious about taking on this challenge, we encourage you to apply today!

Who You Are

- University degree, preferably in Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Extensive experience in data engineering, application design, and analytics within a global organization.
- Industry expert in Snowflake and strong hands-on SQL and dbt experience.
- Senior-level knowledge of Data Warehousing architecture and data modeling techniques such as Data Vault and Dimensional Modeling in an enterprise context.
- Deep knowledge of financial business processes and related core datasets.
- Strong technical skills in cloud computing on AWS or Azure.
- Proficiency in data integration with tools such as dbt, Fivetran, or similar.
- Programming experience in Spark, Kafka, and Python for distributed computation
- Experience in using agentic engineering tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or OpenCode effectively and responsibly within enterprise software development workflows.
- Experience with platforms such as Palantir Foundry, SAP Business Warehouse, or AI engineering platforms is a plus.
- DevOps skills including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), monitoring, and release management.
- Experience in Enterprise Data Architecture, solution design, scalability and performance engineering, migration strategy, data management, security, and governance.
- Proven technical leadership in agile software development, including leading and mentoring engineering teams.
- Ability to establish and promote software engineering best practices.
- Up-to-date with digital trends and emerging technologies.
- Strong ability to facilitate discussions and build consensus by simplifying complex topics and crafting clear, impactful messages for both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; German language skills are a plus.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Embedded & Systems Software Developer for PETRA IV (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Embedded & Systems Software Developer for PETRA IV

Limited: 2 years | Start: 01.01.2027 | ID: FSMA045/2026 | Deadline: 08.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Photon-Science Detector Group designs and builds innovative and state-of-the-art X-ray cameras for us in a variety of scientific experiments, in Hamburg and world wide. We are developing new high-speed cameras for an upcoming major upgrade to our X-ray facilities, PETRA IV, and improved software is required for camera control, data handling, and interfacing to users and the facility's systems. We are looking for a software developer to work on these tasks together with our experts in detector engineering and scientific computing.

With the PETRA IV project, DESY is launching one of the most ambitious and innovative large-scale research projects worldwide. PETRA IV, the most brilliant synchrotron radiation source of the next generation, will be the ultimate 4D X-ray microscope, setting new standards in precision and performance. To implement the project, we are looking for motivated employees who want to get involved in a complex project with international appeal. More information about PETRA IV: PETRA IV (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/696)

About your role:

- Developing software for controlling and configuring a large camera system consisting of multiple units
- Developing a system for receiving detector data at high speed on a set of data acquisition PCs, in collaboration with experts in hardware acceleration
- Developing the interfaces between the X‑ray camera and the facility's control and scientific computing systems

About you:

- Master's degree in software engineering, computer science or equivalent
- Experience with embedded and/or systems programming
- Experience with both Python and a lower-level language (preferably C++)
- Good standard of English
- Good team player, and the ability to work effectively with experts in other fields (firmware developers and detector engineers)
- Experience with high performance computing
- Experience with high-speed networking

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work‑life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV‑AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations

For further information, please contact David Pennicard at +49 40 8998‑4544 (https://tel:+494089984544) (david.pennicard@desy.de (david.pennicard@desy.de) ).

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).

We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:

Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043)

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/2820) is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/699) ).

You can find further information here:
https://www.desy.de/career/apprenticeship/ (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/133043/2/3781)

Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron DESY
Human Resources Department | Notkestraße 85 | 22607 Hamburg

jobs.occupation: Technology Transfer Manager (f/m/d) – Projektmanagement (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
University Medical Center Goettingen (UMG) is committed to systematically strengthening the transfer of scientific findings into medical applications and accelerating the advancement of research for the benefit of patients. The UMG Technology Transfer & Accelerator Office offers an interesting, challenging, and collaborative work environment dedicated to promoting the “transfer” of research findings into medical applications and improving the diagnosis, treatment, and/or prevention of diseases. The UMG Accelerator, as a core element, is a highly professional, multidisciplinary unit that brings together scientific projects with translational potential and therefore collaborates with internal management as well as a wide range of external international consultants and CROs.
This position is funded by the “UMG2032 – Excellence through Focus” project, supported by zukunft.niedersachsen, the joint science funding program of the Lower Saxony Ministry of Science and Culture and the Volkswagen Foundation.

Your tasks

- Familiarize yourself with the research projects at UMG by engaging with researchers and students and systematically analyzing scientific papers and grant proposals for their potential for commercial exploitation
- Evaluate the commercial potential of research projects based on basic and clinical translational research, research findings, and the molecular and clinical validation of a target molecule in comparison to other clinical programs and indications
- Collaboration with contract research organizations (CROs) and external consultants as part of project partnerships
Y- ou possess market knowledge in the life sciences fields relevant to UMG, ranging from medical devices to pharmaceutical products
- Management of databases for translational projects, as well as project and process management and the creation of SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)
- Maintaining working relationships with companies and investors, attending conferences, and reading professional literature

Your qualifications

- Doctorate in natural sciences, biotechnology, or medicine (PhD)
- A MBA or other master’s degree is a plus but not required
- Expertise in the development of a life sciences product or marketing experience with life sciences products at a pharmaceutical company
- Excellent presentation skills and proficiency with standard MS Office programs
- Ability to work in a team, strong execution skills, and good communication skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German
- Experience in drug development and knowledge of regulatory affairs

We offer

- A challenging and varied role within a dedicated and motivated team
- A structured and supportive onboarding process
- Opportunities to develop individual strengths and skills through our comprehensive training and development program
- Support for health and fitness through an excellent workplace health management program and a wide range of attractive benefits (including state-of-the-art facilities, employee discounts at gyms, commuter passes, on-site childcare, and after-school care)
- Compensation in accordance with the state’s collective bargaining agreement for public employees (up to TV-L EG13, subject to meeting the personal requirements), including public-sector benefits such as a supplemental pension (VBL)

jobs.description:
Short and crispAgile project management with changing market requirements awakens a curiosity in you? Do you want to implement projects in a harmonious team with highly competent colleagues?

Then we are looking for you as Senior Project Manager (m/f/d) in a hybrid model for our locations in Aachen, Frankfurt or Paris.

Welcome to aixigo!
Your job – Your passion
• Your role is to lead complex implementation projects. You are responsible for the end-to-end delivery of large and/or complex projects.
• Your tasks include clarifying the scope and defining objectives and milestones.

• You will act as the primary point of contact for senior stakeholders and sponsors, both internally and on the client side. You will manage escalations and facilitate decision-making.
• In addition, you will support the continuous improvement of aixigo’s project management practices.

Your profile – Your strengths
• You have successfully completed your studies in economics, STEM fields, or a related discipline.
• You have 7+ years of professional experience in IT project management of complex projects and a proven track record of delivering projects in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
• You have a keen interest in, or experience with, the financial sector.
• You possess strong risk management and problem-solving abilities.
• You demonstrate strong leadership, communication, and negotiation skills, and have experience working with senior leadership and executive sponsors.
• Furthermore, you have strong skills in process design, documentation, and project management.
• You are a confident communicator in German and English (French is a plus), work independently, are a true team player, and have a keen awareness of the needs of your stakeholders.

Our offer to you
• Great creative freedom and a variety of opportunities for further development in a very trusting and appreciative environment
• The choice between different work models (office or hybrid) with flexible working hours, a working time account, overtime regulations and modern and ergonomically equipped workstations
• State-of-the-art collaboration tools for efficient hybrid working (e. g.,Stackoverflow for Teams)
• A family-friendly and relaxed atmosphere where ideas are created together with the best colleagues on earth!
• Unlimited employment contracts, company pension plan, bonus payments, a future leadership program, development budgets and LinkedIn Learning, sports events, childcare support, cafeteria, health campaigns, bring your dogs to work, sufficient and free parking spaces, bicycle leasing, IT hardware leasing, tire changing service, company and sports events, team excursions and teamchallenges, parcel service, drinks, fresh fruit and vegetables, cookies and much more

jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager Building & Infrastructure (m/f/d) / Engineering (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Project Manager Building & Infrastructure Projects (m/f/d), you will be responsible for the management of demanding technical building, infrastructure, laboratory and production-related projects within Group Real Estate Management - Engineering. You will ensure structured preparation, professional management and successful implementation across all project phases. In this key role, you will combine technical understanding, project management expertise and stakeholder orientation in an international and regulated environment.

In this position, you will actively shape challenging Building & Infrastructure Projects on the Group side and represent Fresenius' interests vis-à-vis internal stakeholders, external project partners, service providers, landlords, authorities, and experts. You will work at the interface of real estate engineering, business units, site organisations, facility management, technical functions and external partners and contribute to shaping professional delivery governance as well as the establishment and further development of GREM-Engineering for technically oriented real estate projects.

Your responsibilities:

- Managing technically oriented building, infrastructure, laboratory and production-related projects as owner’s representative from requirements clarification to handover
- Compilation and clarification of project requirements from business units, location organisations, transaction management, facility management and strategic real estate requirements in a structured manner
- Build resilient project set-ups with scope, budget, schedule, roles, responsibilities, decision-making paths, escalation paths, and reporting logic
- Professionally manage projects through approval, planning, procurement, construction, commissioning support and handover
- Coordinating and managing architects, specialist planners, engineering service providers, project managers, construction partners, general contractors and technical specialists
- Ensure costs, deadlines, quality, scope, compliance, technical functionality, sustainability and operator requirements
- Establish and maintain schedules, budget and forecast structures, risk and opportunity registers as well as change management as central project control instruments
- Prepare status reports, management updates, steering committee documents as well as decision and escalation templates
- Ensure orderly mechanical completion, acceptance, claims management, commissioning, documentation and operator handover
- Further develop standards, methods, templates, quality gates and lessons learned for Building & Infrastructure Projects

Your qualifications:

- Master’s degree in the field of process engineering, civil engineering, architecture, building technology or a comparable qualification
- At least ten years of experience in project management of technical projects, ideally in pharmaceutical, R&D, life science, building infrastructure or comparable regulated environments
- Strong experience as an owner's representative or client-side project manager
- Very good understanding of approval planning, design & construction, commissioning and handover processes in regulated GxP areas
- Solid competence in cost, deadline, risk, claim and change management
- Broad understanding of technical building equipment, infrastructure, user requirements and operability
- Experience in managing external planners, engineering companies, consultants, construction partners and technical service providers
- Strong management competence for complex interfaces between business, sites, operating organisations, engineering, facility management, HSE, IT and external project partners
- Experience in international or matrix-oriented organisations as well as a structured, independent and solution-oriented way of working; combined with the willingness to actively shape the development, professionalisation and further development of GREM-Engineering
- Very good knowledge of German and English, both written and spoken

Why this role is exciting:

In this position, you will actively shape challenging Building & Infrastructure Projects on the Group side and represent Fresenius' interests vis-à-vis internal stakeholders, external project partners, service providers, landlords, authorities, and experts. You will work at the interface of real estate engineering, business units, site organisations, facility management, technical functions and external partners and contribute to shaping professional delivery governance as well as the establishment and further development of GREM-Engineering for technically oriented real estate projects.

Design challenging Building & Infrastructure Projects at Fresenius with technical standards, a clear project structure and a high level of implementation expertise – become part of #futurefresenius and apply now via our online portal.

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description:
VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.

To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.

As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.

Your Responsibilities:

- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope
- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project
- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one
- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time
- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover
- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components
- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it
- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of them

What You Bring:

- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment
- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials
- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)
- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes
- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity
- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement
- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time
- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process

Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. Our principles are first-class teaching and research, international diversity, and transdisciplinary cooperation. According to the 2024 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, Constructor University is among the top 25 percent out of more than 1900 universities worldwide and is ranked as the second most international university in the world. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, over 1,600 students from 110 nations live and study on our residential campus.

The research group led by Prof. Dr. Andrey Ustyuzhanin at Constructor University, in collaboration with Constructor Knowledge Labs (CKL) and Constructor Technology (industry partner), invites applications for Ph.D. student positions in the field of Computer Science, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML).

This PhD position is part of an initiative to advance knowledge representation and adaptive reasoning systems. The research will focus on developing flexible frameworks for actionable knowledge representation that support storage, retrieval, and dynamic adaptation of information across diverse tasks.

Key objectives include:

- Transforming unstructured data into interactive knowledge graphs and personalized cognitive maps.
- Designing models that provide interpretable, persistent, and navigable structures of knowledge.
- Addressing challenges such as hierarchy, composability, and coarse-graining for robust, task-specific reasoning.
- Exploring individual and community-level knowledge modeling, including personalized domain maps, profile extraction from artifacts (e.g., papers, courses), and cross-domain abstraction.

The overarching goal is to create systems that enable transparent, adaptive, and spatially intuitive representations of knowledge, supporting both individual users and collaborative communities.

Your Profile:

- Holding recognized MSc degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, AI, ML, or a related discipline.
- Students holding BSc degree and exhibiting outstanding performance and extraordinary potential can apply for fast-track PhD.
- Strong mathematical background supported with experience in defining and developing knowledge-graph or information retrieval systems.
- Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs) and their applications.
- A track record of publications in AI/ML or related areas.
- Documented experience in practical research work.
- Strong skills in academic English writing (peer-reviewed papers, reports, or equivalent).

- Monthly stipend of €1,650

What you can expect at Constructor University:

jobs.occupation: PhD Researcher (m/f/d) AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Become a part of our journey and join the Constructor Community as:

PhD Researcher (m/f/d): AI for Semantic Structures, Reasoning Flows & Personalized Content Generation

You are expected to contribute to the development of internationally visible, foundational research in AI-driven semantic structure extraction, automated reasoning-flow modeling, and adaptive content generation. The research focuses on methods for analyzing and representing deep semantic and pedagogical structures in scientific and educational materials; high-fidelity extraction of conceptual and reasoning blocks; inference-time rationale generation; and adaptive, learner-aware sequencing of content. This includes work on semantic parsing, structured NLP, graph-based neural models, metacognitive prompting, ontology alignment across disciplines, and human-in-the-loop optimization.

In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged—particularly collaborations spanning computer science, computational linguistics, cognitive science, and the learning sciences. You will contribute to developing datasets, baseline models, personalized learning engines, reasoning-graph representations, cross-domain mapping algorithms, and RLHF-style feedback loops that improve system interpretability and instructional quality. The successful candidate will also contribute to high-quality publications, release research prototypes, and support demonstrator systems that deliver structured semantic extraction, rationale-aware content generation, and cross-domain transfer of reasoning structures.

Additionally, the successful candidate is expected to support teaching activities in areas such as Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, AI in Education, Knowledge Representation, and Python-based analytical seminars at the BSc, MSc, and PhD levels. Responsibilities include assisting in course delivery, advising students, supervising Bachelor/Master theses, and engaging in methodological innovation for online, hybrid, and in-person learning environments. The university provides strong support for early-career researchers, including mentorship, administrative assistance, access to computational resources, conference funding, and opportunities to collaborate with other research groups and industrial partners working at the intersection of AI and digital education.

Your Profile

- Master’s or PhD degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, or a related field.
- Strong research interest and practical experience in one or more of the following areas: - semantic parsing and structured representation learning
- knowledge graphs or graph-based reasoning
- transformer models, sequence modeling, or GNNs
- natural language generation and explainability
- educational AI, personalization algorithms, or cognitive modeling
- Evidence of research potential through publications, a strong thesis, or significant projects.
- Experience or interest in innovative teaching and learning approaches.
- Ability to translate theoretical insights into engineered prototypes and systems supporting scientific or educational use cases.
- Responsible, self-motivated, and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Intercultural competence and experience in international environments.
- Fluency with co-pilot tools for coding and writing.
- Fluency in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus.

Funding & Appointment Terms

The appointment provides full financial coverage through a dedicated fellowship, comprising:

- Monthly stipend of €1,650
- Monthly research-cost allowance of €100 (Forschungskostenpauschale)
- Health-insurance subsidy of €100 per month
- Supplementary €550 mini-job allowance to support parallel part-time employment (optional)

Application Details

- Expected start date: February, 2026

Application package must include:

- Curriculum Vitae (CV)
- Academic transcripts
- A detailed letter of motivation outlining research interests and career goals
- 2 recommendation letters

Applications to be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interviews.
